Lies in a bay sunk into the case floor, under the outer and middle key columns, held with double-sided tape, its lead end towards the battery connector: 2.5 mm below the solder joints under the PCB and at least 15 mm from the controller's antenna end. The connector is about 40 mm from the cell's lead end, so a lead of 60 mm or more reaches it. Check the red wire lands on the PCB's + pad before plugging in. Flown to India in hand luggage, connectors taped.

spec: 1 MΩ resistor, 1206 (R101/R201)

spec: AO3400A N-channel MOSFET, SOT-23 (Q103/Q203)
